mechanism_family: participation-mix microstructure (ticket-size mix as uninformed-retail-flow proxy), cross-sectional contrarian
one_line_mechanism: Weekly, beta-neutral long/short book shorting the USD-M perps whose average trade ticket shrank most relative to their own trailing norm (retail influx) and longing those whose ticket mix thickened, harvesting the underperformance that follows uninformed small-ticket participation.
outcome_blind_attestation: Proposer computed no returns, PnL, PF, Sharpe, ranking or backtest; all numeric statements below are schedule arithmetic (counts, spans, weight algebra) or frozen-contract constants.

primary_source_claim.claim: Small trades proxy uninformed retail investors; heavy small-trade buying predicts negative subsequent stock returns over horizon weeks-to-months, because retail order flow is price-insensitive, contrarian-chasing, and systematically mistimed.

source.title: Small Trades and the Cross-Section of Stock Returns
source.venue: Review of Financial Studies 21(3), 1123-1151 (venue verified 2026-09-03; earlier working-paper citations listing JFQA are superseded)
source.retrieved: 2026-09-03, publisher/SSRN pages resolved via search; verified citation

primary_source_claim.exact_claim_used: small-trade order imbalance (uninformed retail participation) is followed by economically large negative abnormal returns; the small-trade leg of the trade-size cross-section carries predictive content that the large-trade leg does not
crypto_perpetual_transfer_caveats: DIRECTION IS NOT OBSERVED: Binance 15m bars aggregate (volume, quote volume, trade count) with no buy/sell split, so the equity literature's signed small-trade IMBALANCE is unavailable. The mechanism is therefore tested on the ticket-SIZE MIX level (average USD ticket = quote volume / trade count, normalised by the symbol's own trailing norm) as a directional-less proxy for retail presence. This is a strictly weaker identification than Hvidkjaer's and is stated as such; the falsification condition demands the level proxy still beat its sign-flipped control, otherwise the family dies.

Ticket-size buckets in the equity literature are share-count buckets per print; the crypto proxy is a bar-level average over all prints, which blurs the small/medium/large decomposition. Cross-sectional ranks are therefore taken on the WITHIN-SYMBOL normalised ratio (current weekly ticket / trailing 90d median of weekly tickets) so per-symbol price level, lot-size conventions and venue minimum-notional mechanics difference out; raw cross-exchange ticket LEVELS are never compared.

Retail participation in crypto is documented to be large and behaviourally distinct (Kogan, Kogan, Makarov, Marinova & Szydlowski 2023, 'Are Cryptos Different? Evidence from Retail Trading', NBER WP 31317 - working paper, used as a transfer caveat only, not as an anchor claim): retail crypto flow is adoption-narrative driven, which supports mistiming, but the paper does not test ticket-mix predictability in perps.

Derivatives-specific wrapper: on perpetuals the same ticket flow maps to leveraged positioning rather than cash-market holdings; liquidation mechanics can compress or invert the sign at extremes. The weekly horizon and hysteresis bands deliberately avoid holding through the most extreme leverage events; the drop-one-symbol and sign-flip controls bound this risk.
Min-notional and lot-size regimens changed on Binance over time; the within-symbol normalisation uses only trailing data (PIT), so regime changes appear as slow shifts, not lookahead.

economic_counterparty.who: Uninformed retail ticket flow: small-notional market and near-market orders chasing alt moves on perp venues, whose aggregate arrival shifts a symbol's traded-ticket distribution toward small prints.
economic_counterparty.why_they_lose: Price-insensitive, narrative-chasing flow systematically arrives after the move it chases; it supplies liquidity to better-informed participants and leaves the symbol overpriced at the point of maximal retail influx, followed by weeks of underperformance (the Hvidkjaer channel).
economic_counterparty.expected_sign: SHORT the bottom-quintile ticket-mix names (ticket shrank relative to own norm = retail influx), LONG the top-quintile names (ticket thickened = institutional-tilted participation); positive spread for this book net of the frozen cost stack.

fields.field: completed 15m bars: quote-volume and trade-count aggregates
fields.usage: weekly ticket mix: sum(quote volume) / sum(trade count) over bars with close boundary in the half-open week (T-7d, T]; then within-symbol normalisation by the trailing 90d median of the same weekly quantity (approx 12-13 weekly observations, all strictly PIT)
fields.pit_rule: a bar is usable iff its ts_event (close boundary) <= stamp T per data_contract completed-bar definition; gaps are failures, never back-filled

fields.usage: 90d trailing BTC beta used ONLY as the risk-neutralisation constraint (identical estimator to A8-P1), not as signal
fields.pit_rule: only bars with close boundary <= T enter the estimator

pit_fields_and_availability.signal_estimator: ticket_norm_i(T) = [sum_qv_i(week) / sum_trades_i(week)] / median over trailing 12 weekly values; quintile ranks cross-sectionally over eligible names at each stamp
pit_fields_and_availability.availability_clock: signal available AT T = Monday 00:00:00Z; the week (T-7d, T] is fully closed at T; warmup: 90d completed bars for the beta constraint (matches data_contract beta_90d) plus 12 weekly ticket observations from the same window
pit_fields_and_availability.execution_lag: one declared lag: targets emitted at T filled at the first strict-later event after T; stress adds +1 event delay
pit_fields_and_availability.first_decision_stamp: first Monday 00:00:00Z strictly after window start 2025-08-22T00:00:00Z

universe.tradable: the 19 staged Binance USD-M perpetuals excluding BTCUSDT (context-only)
universe.context: BTCUSDT used solely in the beta risk constraint
universe.eligibility_per_stamp: fully covered trailing 90d completed-bar window AND >= 12 weekly ticket observations; if fewer than 9 symbols are eligible the book carries forward unchanged (carried_forward=true, zero turnover at that stamp)

formation_schedule.refresh: ticket-mix ranks recomputed at every stamp
formation_schedule.bucketing: quintile ranks of ticket_norm over eligible names; long leg = top quintile (4 names), short leg = bottom quintile (4 names)

holding_and_rebalance.holding_rule: hysteresis: a long-leg name exits only when its ticket_norm rank leaves the top two quintiles; a short-leg name exits only when its rank leaves the bottom two quintiles; entry requires the extreme quintile
churn_guards: max 2 replacements per leg per stamp
no re-entry within 1 stamp of exit
hard cap: at most 6 exits per symbol per 365d
holding_and_rebalance.rebalance_schedule: weekly stamps only, for leg membership changes or the beta-neutralisation rescale; no intra-week drift correction
holding_and_rebalance.forced_flat: terminal force-flat at the final scored-window boundary (counted separately from discretionary decisions)

target_book.shape: long/short extreme-quintile ticket-mix book (long/short quintile book over the 20-symbol universe, BTC context-only)
construction: equal weights 1/4 per name within each leg
leg scales c_long, c_short chosen so c_long * mean(beta_long) - c_short * mean(beta_short) = 0 (BTC-beta neutral by leg rescaling; beta is a risk constraint here, never the signal)
final clamp w -> w * min(1, 0.30 / max|w|), a pure shrink inside the deterministic target-book constructor BEFORE the stamp is emitted; never a post-score renormalisation
target_book.weight_cap_by_construction: 4 names per leg at equal weights <= 0.25 before the clamp; max|weight| <= 0.30 at every stamp by construction
target_book.beta_neutralisation: sum(w * beta) = 0 at every stamp via the leg-scale ratio; residual net beta is a measurable pipeline output

expected_turnover.median_intended_holding_days_floor: every completed span is a multiple of 7d (weekly clock); floor >= 3d holds by construction
expected_turnover.churn_expectation: ticket-mix ranks drift at weekly-to-monthly scale; hysteresis + churn guards keep replacements to ~0-2 legs per stamp
expected_turnover.floor_verification: decisions/365d, median holding, cost drag and per-symbol turnover share measured by the schedule-only feasibility gate; churn guards designed so no single symbol can plausibly exceed 25% of turnover

controls.anchor: A8-P2-TICKET-MIX-CONTRARIAN: contrarian ticket-mix spread as specified (short retail-influx / long ticket-thickening)
controls.neighbour: informed-participation neighbour: same bar aggregates, transform changed from LEVEL to 4-week TREND of ticket_norm; long the names whose ticket mix is thickening fastest (informed/medium-ticket accumulation), short the fastest-shrinking
controls.neighbour_justification: Barclay & Warner (1993), 'Stealth trading and volatility: Which trades move prices?', Journal of Financial Economics 34(3), 281-305, DOI 10.1016/0304-405X(93)90029-B: informed traders camouflage in medium-size trades, so shifts in the ticket-size distribution toward medium/large prints reveal informed accumulation; the trend of the mix is the theoretically adjacent read-out of the same participation channel that the anchor's level captures in cross-section
controls.causal_negative_control: sign-flipped arm on the identical data pipeline: LONG the bottom-quintile ticket-mix names (retail influx) and SHORT the top quintile, same cost stack. If retail influx carries equal or greater positive predictive content, the uninformed-flow channel is destroyed and the family rejected
controls.secondary_placebo: shuffled-ticket placebo: ticket_norm labels permuted across symbols within each stamp (book shape, leg sizes and cost stack preserved); any spread surviving shuffling is mechanical, not informational
controls.scored_cells_budget: anchor + neighbour + sign-flip control = 3 scored cells for this family (<= max 3/family floor)

cost_treatment.fees: plugin CostModel at the repo's frozen taker-fee floor (tier-0), charged per side on changed notional via the adapter's rebalance_cost_between
cost_treatment.slippage: adverse one-tick slip at each instrument's own tick size (declared 1e-7..1e-2)
cost_treatment.funding: native settlements accrue while held under LONG_PAYS_POSITIVE_RATE, only settlements with ts in (ts_opened, ts_closed]; mixed 8h/4h/1h cadences honoured per symbol; funding is a cost, never a signal input
cost_treatment.stress: preregistered cells: baseline, fee_slippage_x1_5, plus_2_ticks, plus_1_event_delay, drop_one_symbol, drop_one_fold (as supported by the family folds contract); under drop-one-symbol the constructor re-derives leg weights from surviving names and re-applies the 0.30 clamp
cost_treatment.base_cost_drag_expectation: ~0-2 of 8 legs change per weekly stamp; changed notional per stamp small relative to gross; 8%/yr base and 12%/yr stressed drag floors enforced ex ante by the schedule-only feasibility gate

falsification_condition.primary: REJECT the family if, after the frozen cost stack, the sign-flipped causal control (long retail-influx / short ticket-thickening) matches or beats the anchor, or if the shuffled-ticket placebo is indistinguishable from the anchor: either outcome means the ticket-mix label carries no uninformed-flow content.
falsification_condition.secondary: REJECT if the drop-one-symbol stress cell overturns the anchor's sign (single-name or single-listing-event dependence of the mix), if eligible names < 9 at more than 20% of stamps, or if any frozen schedule floor fails at the feasibility gate.
falsification_condition.no_rescue_clause: a FAIL is terminal for the family in this sprint: no re-bucketing of ticket sizes, no normalisation-window retune, no fee reduction, no winning-symbol selection may follow.

ancestry_map_vs_v1_v11.distinction: aggressor absorption requires taker buy/sell direction panels; this proposal uses only direction-less aggregates (quote volume, trade count) — no order-side variable exists in the pipeline

Amihud illiquidity = |return| / dollar-volume: a PRICE-IMPACT ratio (price term in the numerator). Ticket mix = dollar-volume / trade count: a PARTICIPATION-GRANULARITY ratio with NO price term. The two can fully decorrelate (high-volume many-small-trade names are liquid yet retail-heavy). No |r|, no price input of any kind enters the signal; this is not a parameter, window or transformation rescue of the Amihud identity

volume-shock continuation conditions on volume MAGNITUDE shocks and predicts continuation; this proposal conditions on the volume/trades MIX (no magnitude shock trigger) and predicts the CONTRARIAN direction
no return-distribution shape statistic (max, skew, vol) anywhere; the signal never touches returns
no past-return ranking at any horizon; the sorting variable is a microstructure mix
ordinary reversal sorts on past returns; this book never reads a return — a symbol can be shorted here without having risen, purely on its participation mix
funding never enters the signal; accrued passively as a cost only
uses only frozen in-contract bar fields (quote volume, trade count, close); no external or purchased data

why_not_a_rescue.not_lot_inversion: no idiosyncratic skew/MAX/volatility statistic is computed; the signal never touches the return series. The mechanism is participation-mix mispricing, not lottery-demand inversion.
why_not_a_rescue.not_illiq_rescue: the Amihud identity is |return|/dollar-volume (price impact). The ticket ratio is dollar-volume/trade count (participation granularity) with no price term; it is a different physical quantity measuring WHO trades rather than HOW MUCH price moves per dollar, and the reserved-family replication identity is nowhere parameterised, inverted or transformed here.
why_not_a_rescue.not_oilev_rescue: zero open-interest fields; no deleveraging or OI-change term.
why_not_a_rescue.not_a_renamed_baseline: no V1-V11 class in the inventory sorts cross-sectionally on traded-ticket granularity; volume-shock continuation, aggressor absorption and Amihud each require a variable (volume magnitude shock, order direction, price impact) that is absent from this pipeline by construction.

data_fields_used: completed 15m bars: close (beta risk constraint only)

frozen_floor_compliance_schedule_arithme.base_and_stressed_cost_drag: enforced ex ante by the schedule-only feasibility gate on emitted books; churn guards keep changed notional per stamp small
frozen_floor_compliance_schedule_arithme.max_symbol_turnover_share: verified by gate; churn guards (max 2 swaps/leg/stamp, re-entry rest, <=6 exits/symbol/365d) designed to keep any single symbol well under 25%
